stories.title: Inside the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow
stories.summary: BBC News has published a short video report about the Russia-Africa summit in Moscow. The BBC's accompanying listing says more than 20 heads of state arrived for the summit. Read or watch the original report for context; PixelHive has not independently verified the full video contents.
